name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardExternalGuideActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the guide for an external-app reward task. It explains how to try the advertised app before continuing the task.
disableEffect: The guide for this ad-reward task will no longer appear, so users cannot follow this route to its reward.
